title: What Makes a Representation Good for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction?
key_claim_en: arXiv 2605.19343, accepted to ICML 2026 (Jiang and six co-authors, submitted 19 May 2026): argues that gene expression is dominated by perturbation-invariant information while perturbation-specific signals are intrinsically sparse, so learned representations either entangle the two (spurious, non-generalizable predictors) or suppress the perturbation-specific signal; introduces PerturbedVAE, which separates perturbation-specific information from the dominant invariant structure, with an identifiability analysis of when sparse perturbation effects can be recovered; reports state-of-the-art results on a widely used benchmark with larger gains on out-of-distribution combinations (abstract and poster summary; tables not checked)
key_claim_zh: arXiv 2605.19343，已被 ICML 2026 接收（Jiang 等 7 位作者，2026 年 5 月 19 日提交）：认为基因表达以与扰动无关的信息为主，而扰动特异信号本质上是稀疏的，所以学得的表示要么把两者纠缠在一起（产生虚假的、不可泛化的预测器），要么抑制扰动特异信号；提出 PerturbedVAE，把扰动特异信息与占主导的不变结构分开，并给出稀疏扰动效应何时可被恢复的可识别性分析；报告在一个广泛使用的基准上达到最先进水平，在分布外组合上提升更大（摘要和海报摘要层面；未核对表格）

title: Generative inverse design steers human hematopoietic cell fate in vitro (LabCompass preprint)
key_claim_en: inverse-modeling framework that optimizes experimental designs toward candidates expected to produce specified target cell states, using a flow-matching generative model guided by phenotypes predicted by a forward surrogate; applied to primary human CD34+ cultures in which continuous cytokine and small-molecule parameters govern cell fate; in four lab-in-the-loop rounds, model-driven designs were tested and the measurements fed back; the authors report recovery of known lineage-inducing designs, improved predictions as data arrived, enrichment of target populations across lineages, a wider design space when parameters were added, the same target states reached from different culture conditions, and a 78-million-cell spectral flow cytometry dataset; Fabian Theis is a corresponding author; posted in early October 2026 (DOI suffix 2026.10.07.756550); no peer-reviewed version or independent replication found; only abstract-level text was read

title: theislab/LabCompass (GitHub)
key_claim_en: BSD-3-Clause licence (copyright holders Lorenzo Consoli and Alessandro Palma), version 0.0.1, Python 3.10 or newer, dependencies include torch 1.11.0 or newer, torchdiffeq, POT and AnnData; the README describes generative modeling for experimental design in single-cell data with a conditional flow-matching forward model (FlowMatching, FlowMatchingWithScore and a few-step FlowMap), perturbation covariates held in AnnData .obs with one encoder per representation, an InverseModel (MAP, Langevin or amortized), a TargetPredictionModel (supervised proxy) and training-free guidance; LossGuidedFlow predicts the endpoint by one Euler step that assumes a linear path (or by a flow map), evaluates a loss at that endpoint, takes the vector-Jacobian gradient with respect to the current state and returns the velocity minus a user-scheduled multiple of that gradient, integrated with Euler over 100 steps by default and without gradient normalization; ImpliciDualGuidedFlow replaces the loss by a KKT Lagrangian for inequality constraints g_i(x1) <= 0, with options for a least-squares multiplier solve and an active-set tolerance, but the multiplier code in kkt.py was not read; the README example uses synthetic random states and does not discuss the prior or uncertainty
key_claim_zh: BSD-3-Clause 许可（版权持有人 Lorenzo Consoli 和 Alessandro Palma），版本 0.0.1，Python 3.10 或更高，依赖包括 torch 1.11.0 或更高、torchdiffeq、POT 和 AnnData；README 描述了面向单细胞数据实验设计的生成建模：条件流匹配前向模型（FlowMatching、FlowMatchingWithScore 和少步 FlowMap）、存放在 AnnData 的 .obs 中且每种表示各有一个编码器的扰动协变量、InverseModel（MAP、Langevin 或摊销）、TargetPredictionModel（监督代理模型）以及免训练引导；LossGuidedFlow 用假设路径为线性的一步 Euler（或用流映射）预测终点，在该终点处计算损失，对当前状态求向量-雅可比梯度，并返回速度减去该梯度按用户设定计划缩放的倍数，默认用 Euler 积分 100 步，不做梯度归一化；ImpliciDualGuidedFlow 用针对不等式约束 g_i(x1) <= 0 的 KKT 拉格朗日量取代损失，提供最小二乘求解乘子和活动集容差的选项，但 kkt.py 中的乘子代码未读；README 的示例使用合成的随机状态，且没有讨论先验或不确定性
so_what_en: a ready, permissively licensed implementation of the guidance mechanism, usable as a baseline; at version 0.0.1 its README says nothing about the prior or about uncertainty
so_what_zh: 引导机制的现成的、许可宽松的实现，可作为基线使用；在 0.0.1 版本，其 README 对先验和不确定性只字未提

title: theislab/LabCompass-reproducibility (GitHub)
key_claim_en: the GitHub description calls it the repository for the collaboration with the Göttgens lab on spectral flow cytometry data; the README lists a pipeline of datasets (cumulative loop datasets chained loop0, loop1, loop2, loop2p5, loop3, loop4, loop4p5, loop5), forward models (conditional flow matching plus a cell-type classifier), a protocol prior (optionally distilled into a few-step flow-map student), inverse design (defaults of 50 candidates and 350 forward passes each, sweeping target cell type, scheduler, optimisation type and query type), uncertainty (re-scoring under many noise draws, for example 5,000) and plots; Hugging Face artefacts are about 60 GB of loop measurements (loop 0 alone is 36 GB), 4.7 GB of derived inputs, 13 GB of inference-only checkpoints (priors cannot be retrained from them) and about 1.07 million unfiltered designs (445 MB); it also installs scopt, described as an optimisation baseline; some loop 2.5 solutions lack uncertainty estimates
key_claim_zh: GitHub 描述称它是与 Göttgens 实验室合作处理光谱流式细胞术数据的仓库；README 列出的流程为：数据集（累积的各轮数据集，链条为 loop0、loop1、loop2、loop2p5、loop3、loop4、loop4p5、loop5）、前向模型（条件流匹配加细胞类型分类器）、方案先验（可选地蒸馏为少步流映射学生模型）、逆向设计（默认 50 个候选、每个 350 次前向传播，并对目标细胞类型、调度器、优化类型和查询类型做扫描）、不确定性（在大量噪声抽样下重新打分，例如 5,000 次）以及绘图；Hugging Face 上的产物为约 60 GB 的各轮测量（仅 loop 0 就有 36 GB）、4.7 GB 的衍生输入、13 GB 仅用于推理的检查点（无法据此重新训练先验），以及约 1.07 million（107 万）个未过滤的设计（445 MB）；它还安装 scopt，被描述为优化基线；部分 loop 2.5 的解缺少不确定性估计

title: Mechanisms Matter: Transportability of Cellular Perturbation Effects
key_claim_en: bioRxiv 2026 preprint by Qi and Chapfuwa (Vector Institute, University of Toronto), described by a secondary listing as an ICML 2026 submission: a causal-transportability argument that cross-context prediction depends on shared causal mechanisms rather than on dataset similarity; a causal simulator generates semi-synthetic Perturb-seq data with adjustable mechanistic divergence, and the Vendi diversity score is adapted as a mode-collapse diagnostic; across four deep learning models and six simple baselines, cross-context performance drops substantially, often to baseline level, and even on synthetic data with fully specified causal structure no model generalized across contexts with different mechanisms (abstract and third-party summary level)
key_claim_zh: bioRxiv 2026 年预印本，作者 Qi 和 Chapfuwa（Vector Institute，多伦多大学），一份二手列表称其为 ICML 2026 投稿：因果可迁移性论证，认为跨背景预测取决于共享的因果机制，而不是数据集相似度；因果模拟器生成机制差异可调的半合成 Perturb-seq 数据，并改造 Vendi 多样性得分作为模式塌缩诊断；在四个深度学习模型和六个简单基线上，跨背景表现大幅下降，常降到基线水平，即使在因果结构完全已知的合成数据上，也没有模型能在机制不同的背景之间泛化（摘要和第三方摘要层面）
so_what_en: the strongest warning for genotype-aware transfer: a variant that changes the mechanism defines a context in which transport should fail unless the mechanism is modeled; a simulator with adjustable divergence gives a unit test for the world model
so_what_zh: 对基因型感知迁移最有力的警告：改变机制的变异定义了一个背景，除非对机制建模，否则迁移应当失败；机制差异可调的模拟器为世界模型提供单元测试
caveat_en: Read at abstract or search-excerpt level only; the full text was not retrieved (tier T2).
caveat_zh: 只读到摘要或检索摘录层面；未取回全文（T2 级）。

title: A mechanism-annotated benchmark reveals limited fidelity to drug-response signatures in single-cell perturbation models (scDrugPerturb-Bench)
key_claim_en: scDrugPerturb-Bench pairs matched control and drug-treated scRNA-seq with literature-curated key-gene evidence: 181 datasets, 423 response cases and 717 key genes; its Mechanism Fidelity Score checks key-gene direction, effect-size recovery, gene-set coherence, mechanism specificity and pathway-level polarity; across 12 perturbation models and 3 baselines, expression-similarity metrics correlated only weakly with the score and selected different configurations; hard-negative tests show that plausible responses can arise from non-specific transcriptional shortcuts (preprint, unreviewed)
key_claim_zh: scDrugPerturb-Bench 把匹配的对照和药物处理的 scRNA-seq 与文献整理的关键基因证据配对：181 个数据集、423 个响应案例、717 个关键基因；机制保真度评分检查关键基因方向、效应大小恢复、基因集一致性、机制特异性和通路层面的极性；在 12 个扰动模型和 3 个基线中，表达相似度指标与该评分只有弱相关，并选出不同的配置；难负例检验表明，看似合理的响应可能来自非特异的转录捷径（预印本，未经评审）
so_what_en: a mechanism-level check to add to the evaluation battery; for genotype-by-drug it should be applied per genotype, for example whether the programme that stays off in TP53-mutant lines is predicted to stay off
so_what_zh: 可加入评测清单的机制层面检查；对基因型×药物应按基因型分别应用，例如在 TP53 突变系中保持关闭的程序是否被预测为保持关闭
caveat_en: Read at abstract or search-excerpt level only; the full text was not retrieved (tier T2).
caveat_zh: 只读到摘要或检索摘录层面；未取回全文（T2 级）。

title: Drug Response Prediction Provides a Biologically Relevant Benchmark for Perturbation Response Models
key_claim_en: Brouwer et al. bioRxiv preprint (DOI date 2025.12.09, not peer reviewed): perturbation response models are evaluated by how well their generated profiles support downstream drug-response prediction; simple baselines roughly match the models at reconstructing post-treatment profiles, yet drug-response predictors trained on model-generated profiles outperform those trained on baseline or pretreatment profiles, which the authors attribute to retained variation in response-relevant genes; the McFarland dataset is used with four settings (unseen cell line–drug pairs, unseen cell lines, unseen drugs, both unseen), and cell lines of the same tissue are kept entirely in training or test to limit lineage confounding (abstract and figure-legend level)
key_claim_zh: Brouwer 等的 bioRxiv 预印本（DOI 日期 2025.12.09，未经同行评议）：通过模型生成的谱对下游药物响应预测的支持程度来评估扰动响应模型；简单基线在重建处理后谱方面与模型大体相当，但用模型生成的谱训练的药物响应预测器优于用基线谱或处理前谱训练的预测器，作者将其归因于模型保留了与响应相关基因的变异；使用 McFarland 数据集和四种设置（未见细胞系–药物对、未见细胞系、未见药物、两者皆未见），并让同一组织的细胞系整体处于训练集或测试集中，以限制谱系混杂（摘要和图注层面）
so_what_en: a downstream-utility benchmark with lineage-grouped splits; for this project the analogue is whether generated genotype-conditioned profiles improve genotype-aware drug-response prediction
so_what_zh: 带谱系分组划分的下游效用基准；对本项目而言，类比是生成的、以基因型为条件的谱能否改进基因型感知的药物响应预测
caveat_en: Read at abstract or search-excerpt level only; the full text was not retrieved (tier T2).
caveat_zh: 只读到摘要或检索摘录层面；未取回全文（T2 级）。

title: Benchmarking virtual cell models for in-the-wild perturbation response
key_claim_en: arXiv 2604.27646, submitted 30 April 2026 by Mao, Zhang and 11 co-authors: a standardized modular framework evaluating unseen cell contexts, unseen perturbations and cross-dataset generalization; the authors report that performance is inflated under standard setups, that naive dataset aggregation can reduce performance, that simple linear methods capture global trends but miss fine-grained perturbation-specific effects, and that rankings depend on the metric; a ResearchGate listing describes 27 methods, 29 datasets and 6 metrics, the same counts as scPerturBench (EV03), but the link between the two was not confirmed; an automated Pith review notes that splits may still mix dataset artifacts (third-party)
key_claim_zh: arXiv 2604.27646，Mao、Zhang 和 11 位共同作者于 2026 年 4 月 30 日提交：标准化的模块化框架，评估未见细胞背景、未见扰动和跨数据集泛化；作者报告，在标准设置下性能被夸大，朴素的数据集聚合可能降低性能，简单线性方法能捕获全局趋势但抓不住细粒度的扰动特异效应，且排名取决于指标；ResearchGate 列表描述为 27 种方法、29 个数据集和 6 个指标，与 scPerturBench（EV03）的数目相同，但两者之间的联系未经证实；自动化的 Pith 评审指出，划分仍可能混入数据集伪影（第三方）
so_what_en: separate splits for unseen context, unseen perturbation and unseen dataset belong in the evaluation checklist (J5); for genotype-aware models, unseen genotype is a fourth split
so_what_zh: 清单（J5）中应对未见背景、未见扰动和未见数据集分别划分；对基因型感知模型，未见基因型是第四种划分

caveat_zh: 只读到摘要或检索摘录层面；未取回全文（T2 级）。 数字和主张由作者或公司自报。

title: mlbio-epfl/systema (GitHub)
key_claim_en: the README describes a pipeline that runs CPA, GEARS and scGPT plus two non-parametric baselines (a non-control mean and a matching mean) on eight datasets (Adamson, Norman, Xu, Replogle RPE1 and K562, Frangieh, Tian CRISPRa and CRISPRi), and introduces two metrics: Pearson correlation on delta profiles with the centroid of the perturbed cells as the reference, and centroid accuracy, which asks whether a predicted post-perturbation profile is closer to its own perturbation's ground-truth centroid than to the centroids of other perturbations; the page shows 69 commits and a Zenodo DOI; the README gives no formal metric equations, no results and no licence
key_claim_zh: README 描述了一条流程，在八个数据集（Adamson、Norman、Xu、Replogle RPE1 和 K562、Frangieh、Tian CRISPRa 和 CRISPRi）上运行 CPA、GEARS 和 scGPT，外加两个非参数基线（非对照均值和匹配均值），并引入两个指标：以扰动后细胞质心为参照的 delta 谱 Pearson 相关，以及质心准确度，它检验预测的扰动后谱是否比其他扰动的质心更接近自己所属扰动的真实质心；页面显示 69 次提交和一个 Zenodo DOI；README 没有给出指标的形式化公式，没有结果，也没有许可
so_what_en: two implementable metrics for the evaluation battery, a delta-profile correlation referenced to the perturbed-cell centroid and a centroid-accuracy test of whether predictions stay distinguishable between perturbations; for genotype-by-drug work the analogue is to ask whether a predicted profile is closest to its own genotype-and-drug combination
so_what_zh: 评测清单可用的两个可实现的指标：以扰动后细胞质心为参照的 delta 谱相关，以及检验预测在不同扰动之间是否仍可区分的质心准确度；对基因型×药物而言，类比是问预测谱是否最接近其自身的基因型与药物组合
caveat_en: Repository page and README retrieved in this session through a summarizing fetch tool; statements that something is absent are that tool's report. No licence is shown on the page or in the README and a LICENSE file was not found (HTTP 404), so reuse terms are unclear. The README lists eight datasets whereas the paper summary EV29 mentions ten, and its link to the processing notebooks points to another repository (perturb-bench).
caveat_zh: 仓库页面和 README 在本会话中通过带摘要功能的抓取工具取回；关于“没有某内容”的陈述是该工具的报告。页面和 README 都没有显示许可，也没有找到 LICENSE 文件（HTTP 404），因此复用条款不明。README 列出八个数据集，而论文摘要 EV29 提到十个，其处理笔记本的链接指向另一个仓库（perturb-bench）。
